summary: Configured persistent internal time synchronization. Node1 (10.100.45.10) serves NTP to node2, while node2 uses node1 as its sole source. Both nodes remained healthy and synchronized after sequential reboots with changed boot IDs.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled chrony on both Ubuntu 16.04 nodes.
Disabled systemd-timesyncd to avoid competing time services.
Configured node1 with an upstream source, local fallback, and NTP access restricted to node2.
Verified active synchronization and performed sequential reboot/recovery validation on both nodes.

evidence.requirement: Node1 is the cluster's internal time source
evidence.summary: Configuration permits node2, chrony is active/enabled, UDP/123 is listening, and node1 has normal upstream synchronization.

evidence.requirement: Node2 synchronizes against node1 instead of a public server
evidence.summary: The sole configured source is 10.100.45.10; chrony selects it (^*), reports Reference ID 10.100.45.10, and has normal leap status.

Healthy baseline; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594 to 5cfe50e9-cc75-4c29-99de-9ed1e0f6e6ce; chrony, configuration, listener, and synchronization recovered.

Healthy baseline; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from ac73b359-243e-418e-b7bb-a7cff423e597 to f12ad3b3-62d3-445d-a944-789fff5cd168; persisted configuration recovered and node1 was again selected as the active source.
